paite: Dal maitam, adunglam tong sawmnih, availam tong sawmnih, asandan tong sawm abawl hi.
heading: Tempul Vanzatte / (1 Kum 7.23-51)

paite: Dal lohbem lianpi, agei leh agei kikal a tong sawm kia, asandan tong nga abawl a; agei akimvel in tong sawmthum ahi.
Agei nuai bawngtal limte in avelsuak a, tong khat ah sawm zel, dal loh kimvel in a-om hi. Bawngtal limte vual nih ahi a, dal loh akimat a sun ahi.

Huchi in bel bawngtal sawm-le-nih tung ah akinga a, thum in mallam anga ua, thum in tumlam anga ua, thum in simlam anga ua, thum in suahlam anga uh; dal loh bel huaite tung ah akoih a, anunglam anga hi.
Loh pen khutpek tan in asah a, agei ahihleh nou gei bangbang, lili pak bang a bawl ahi a, bath sangthum ta ahi.
Kisilna ding kuangzawn, sawm abawl lai a, taklam sang ah nga atung a, veilam sang ah nga atung a; huaite bel halmang thillat silna ding ahi; huan, dal lohbem bel siampute kisilna ding ahi.
Huan bawldan ding a aseh bang in, dangka-eng khawnvak koihna sawm abawl a, tempul sung taklam ah nga, veilam ah nga akoih hi.
Dohkan sawm abawl lai a, tempul sung ah taklam ah nga, veilam ah nga akoih a, dangka-eng kuangzawn zakhat abawl hi.
Huai lou leng siampute huang leh huang zapite a-um a, huang kongkhakte abawl a, dal in aluan hi.
Loh pen inn taklam pang ah suahlam ah simdoh in atung hi.
Huram in belte, vutluahnate, kuangzawnte abawl hi. Huchi in Pathian inn a ding a kumpipa Solomon abawlsak Huram in azouta hi.
Khuam nihte, noubemte khuam dawn a zing nihte, khuam dawn a noubem nihte tuamna gial chitek nihte;
huai tuamna gial chitek nih ding a theibuhfai zalite khuam dawn a noubial nih tuamna ding gial chitek tuaktuak ding a theibuhfai vual nihte.
Kingaknate, kingakna tung a kuangzawnte leng abawl a;
Loh khat leh anuai a bawngtal sawm-le-nihte toh.
Belte, vutluahnate, sa thuknate leh atui-um belsuan tengteng leng Huram in TOUPA' inn a dia dal nawttet akumpipa Solomon abawlsak ahi.
Huaite Jordan Phaizang ah Sukoth leh Zered bellei mun ah kumpipa'n asung hi.
Huchibang in Solomon in tui-um belsuan tampi abawl a; dal gikzah buk seng vual ahi kei hi.
Solomon in Pathian inn a tui-um belsuan om tengteng abawl a, dangka-eng maitamte, tanghou koihna dohkante.
Seh bang a mun siangthou mai adet ding khawnvak koihnate, akhawnvak nangawn toh, dangka-eng ngen in abawl hi.
Dangka-eng pakte, khawnvakte leh taitehte, dangka-eng siang ngen in abawl hi.

Khawnvak puantehnate, maiphiat kuangte, keute, mei laknate dangka-eng siang ngen mah in; huan, insung lutna, insung gilzaw Mun Siangthoupen kongkhakte leh a-inn, tempul kongkhakte dangka-eng in abawl hi.
